description: Require exact cohort, censoring and observation semantics plus an approved lifetime Model before producing estimates.

guide.applicability: Use to assess forecast readiness for a reviewed acquisition cohort and observation horizon.
guide.context_boundary: Narrative benchmarks and historical examples are not lifetime labels, censoring rules or model validation evidence.
steps: Resolve cohort entry, activity, churn, censoring and observation-window semantics.
Verify the exact lifetime Model lineage, evaluation, approval, expiry and safe horizon.
Stop at a model gap unless all requirements hold; otherwise distinguish observations, estimates and assumptions.
guide.title: Player lifetime readiness assessment

summary: Determine whether a bounded player-lifetime estimate has validated model support.
